mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, leading to wage inflation and increased production costs, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real GDP (GDPC1) above 3% quarter-over-quarter signals strong economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 QoQ > 3% and 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < -1% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy and inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 10% month-over-month and real GDP (GDPC1) grows by more than 2% quarter-over-quarter, the combined signal indicates strong economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST MoM > 10% and GDPC1 QoQ > 2% and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 month-over-month signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS MoM < -100,000 and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When real final sales of domestic product (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% month-over-month, it signals increased consumer spending and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS MoM > 1% and 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
